senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. עָדָה)to turn, return, occur; to continue, endure, exist (v. Ges. Thes. s. v.).—Denom. עַד, עוֹד, עֵת &c.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 146:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVI, 9</cite> <he>וכי כל … מְעוֹדֵד</he> does the Lord uphold all widows and orphans?—*Part. pass. <he>מְעוֹדָד</he>; pl. <he>מְעוֹדָדִים</he>, <he>מְעוֹדָדִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 1:3">Tosef. Makhsh. I, 3</cite> <he>שק אחד מע׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מעודר</he>, Var. <he>מועדר</he>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:4">Makhsh. I, 4</cite> <he>מעורר</he>; Makhsh. l. c. <he>מלא פירות</he>) one bag standing upright (closely packed); ib. <he>שני שקין מע׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מעודרון</he>, Var. <he>מעודדי</he>, R. S. <he>מעוררין</he>).

senses.gloss: to declare one’s presence at a certain occurrence, esp. to establish a law from a witnessed precedent or traditional knowledge.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:1">Eduy. II, 1</cite> <he>ר׳ חנינא</he> … <he>ה׳ וכ׳</he> R. H. … related four things which he knew by tradition.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>אף הוא ה׳ על וכ׳</he> he also reported as a precedent the case of a small village &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to testify before court. Ib. IV, 11 מי שהיו … מְעִידוֹת אותו he concerning whom there were two sets of witnesses testifying; אלו מְעִידִים וכ׳ the ones testifying that &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:1">Macc. I, 1</cite> <he>מעידין אנו באיש … שגירש וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. 3ᵃ … <he>את איש</he>) we testify about this man that he divorced &c. Ib. 2, sq.; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:7">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>וממהר להָעִידוֹ</he> and is quick to testify against him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 589:8">Yalk. Mal. 589</cite> <he>ומֵעִיד בו</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:6">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>מְעִידֵנִי עלי וכ׳</he> I call upon heaven and earth as my witnesses &c.; <cite ref="Arakhin 16b:31">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מעיד אני וכ׳</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to forewarn, exhort. Lev. R. l. c. שבעה נביאים … והן מעידין וכ׳ seven prophets stood up for the nations exhorting them; לא הֵעִידוּ בנו they have not warned us; גירי הדור מעידין בדור the proselytes of every generation are an exhortation to their respective generation; a. e.—Esp. to forewarn the owner of a noxious animal; to declare an animal noxious (v. מוּעָד).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:4">B. Kam. II, 4</cite> <he>כל שהֵעִידוּ בו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M00556"><he>מוּעָד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 24a:11">Ib. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיָעִידוּ בו וכ׳</he> unless he be declared noxious (testimony be deposited stating the facts on which the declaration is based) in the presence of the owner and in court.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 24a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הֵעִידוּהוּ שנים וכ׳</he> if the first case has been ascertained by two witnesses &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00556"><he>מוּעָד</he></cite> q. v.
